<thought>We need to find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for the target molecule (the product of the carbonyl‑ene cyclization). Using the derived product SMILES, we will search the template catalog with criteria that match the forward reaction: breaking a ketone and an alkene, forming an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring. This will give us the template_id to use in the final route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC[C@@]1(O)C(F)(F)F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkene"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyl", "five-membered ring"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
